pathway_hierarchy_v<N>: Holds pathway-to-pathway relationships; grain = one row per parent-child pathway pair; keys/measures = parent_id, child_id.
pe_to_pathway_v<N>: Maps physical entities to pathways; grain = one row per physical-entity-to-pathway association; keys/measures = pe_stable_id, pathway_stable_id, evidence_code.
physical_entity_v<N>: Describes physical entities (molecules/proteins); grain = one row per physical entity record; keys/measures = ensembl_id, uniprot_id, stable_id, name, location.
pathway_v<N>: Catalog of pathways; grain = one row per pathway; keys/measures = stable_id, url, name, species, lowest_level.
target_synonyms_v<N>: Lists alternate names for targets; grain = one row per target-synonym pairing; keys/measures = targetID, synonym.
sources_v<N>: Records metadata about data sources; grain = one row per source/version/download event; keys/measures = sourceID, PubMedID, databaseName, db_version, db_downloadURL, db_downloadDate.
interactions_v<N>: Drug–target interaction records; grain = one row per reported interaction (interactionID); keys/measures = interactionID, drugID, targetID, interactionType, drugName, drug_approvalDate, drug_atcClassID, drug_atcClassName, drug_atcClassStatus, drug_epcClassID, drug_epcClassName, targetName, targetType, target_uniprotID, targetSpecies, sourceID, expID.
experiments_v<N>: Experimental measurement metadata for interactions/assays; grain = one row per experiment/assay (expID); keys/measures = expID, exp_assayType, exp_assayValueLow, exp_assayValueMedian, exp_assayValueHigh, exp_assayUnits, exp_assayRelation, exp_assayDescription, exp_assaySpecies, exp_parentSource, sourceID, PubMedID, databaseName, db_version, db_downloadURL, db_downloadDate.
drug_synonyms_v<N>: Lists alternate names for drugs; grain = one row per drug-synonym pairing; keys/measures = drugID, synonym.
